errors.text: The target FeNiCrMn single crystal is replaced by a CoCrFeNi-like polycrystalline alloy, changing both composition and defect-nucleation environment.

The proposed experimental strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^-1 s^-1 does not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics range of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1, so the stated rate-insensitivity boundary is not the target boundary.

Yielding is attributed mainly to edge and mixed dislocation glide rather than nucleation of 1/6<112> Shockley partials at vacancy clusters followed by intrinsic and extrinsic stacking-fault formation.

The cited evidence primarily establishes phase constitution or thermal stability and does not directly support the claimed dislocation character, strain-rate insensitivity, or suppression of twinning.
